name: UK inflation & rates
summary: UK inflation 3.5%; Bank of England expected to raise Bank Rate to 4% on 5 Nov
state: UK CPI inflation rose to 3.5% in September, within the 2.5–4.0% Watch band. A Bloomberg survey published on 2 Nov found economists expect the Bank of England to raise Bank Rate from 3.75% to 4% on 5 Nov, its first rise since 2023. Markets price further rises in 2027.
for_you: Tracker and variable mortgage payments would rise after a Bank Rate increase; fixed deals already priced it in.

sources.title: Bloomberg — BoE to raise rates for first time since 2023, survey shows

why: UK inflation and the Bank Rate set mortgage, savings and business borrowing costs for the whole country.
drivers: Energy prices, wages, services inflation, sterling, global rates.

rubric.alert: CPI > 4.0%, or an emergency BoE move.
rubric.watch: CPI 2.5–4.0%, or the BoE reversing course.
rubric.normal: CPI ≤ 2.5% and Bank of England moving gradually or on hold.
